newsitem.title: USA: Lear Corp files to offer 9 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Lear Corp files to offer 9 million shares.

text.p: Lear Corp filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration for up to nine million common shares to be sold in a secondary offering by Lehman Funds.
Of the total amount, 7.2 million common will be offered in the United States and Canada and 1.8 million common will be sold outside the U.S. and Canada.
Lehman Funds has granted the U.S. underwriters and international managers a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 1,284,854 additional common shares.
The offering will be made through Lehman Brothers, Donaldson, Lukfin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, Salomon Brothers Inc and Schroder Wertheim & Co, Lear said in the filing.
Lear, based in Southfield, Mich., is an independent supplier of automotive interior products to the global automotive interior market.
